sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No. 3416 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.87 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Chinaganjam Police Station, Prakasam District, against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 270, 273, 328 R/W.34 IPC, Section 24(I) R/w.27 of COTPA, 2003, Section 4 of Gutka and Pan Masala (Prohibition) Act, 2015 and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standard Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.

Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on the common orders dated 27.08.2018 and 18.12.2019 passed in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 & batch and Crl.P.Nos.5421 of 2019 & Batch respectively by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in FIR No.87 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Chinaganjam Police Station, Prakasam District, against the petitioners, are hereby quashed; consequently no further action is necessary in the facts of the case.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.

_________________ JUSTICE D.RAMESH 27th August, 2020 Mjl/* CC by today R Madhu Kumar vs The State Of Ap on 27 August, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81926215/
